:::: smt-section
::: smt-prose
Kia ora, I'm Steven, a data scientist and researcher from New Zealand (born in England), now living in San Diego. I've been lucky enough to have done some cool things:

- I started out as a researcher in the sociology of education, and did a PhD [looking at student pathways through tertiary education](https://hdl.handle.net/2292/54611).
- I was a member of [Te Pūnaha Matitini's Covid Modelling Aotearoa team](https://pmscienceprizes.org.nz/2020-prime-ministers-science-prize-winner/), where I helped develop [synthetic population network models](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.lanwpc.2021.100351) for contagion modelling.
- I've worked as a Data Scientist helping social and health sector organisations, building automated and reproducible analytical pipelines, evaluating programmes, and lending a hand to whatever issues people face.

I love learning new skills, and this passion has built a repertoire spanning programming (R, Python, SQL), survey design and administration, geospatial analysis, web development, applications of AI, qualitative analysis... the list goes on! I like stepping out of my comfort zone and picking up new skills to solve the problems I come across.

:::
